scope: Four species with observed body translation: Carnotaurus, Triceratops, Tyrannosaurus, Deinonychus. Explicit integer whole-pose registration after fixed source sampling. Raw masters unchanged; no centroid/bbox recentering, resizing or anatomy drawing. Registration targets the canonical idle anatomical point, retaining the existing logical render/collision origin and recording the anatomical offset explicitly. Additional source-row placement corrections checked in body-point grids for Utahraptor, Ankylosaurus, Pachycephalosaurus, Gallimimus, Baryonyx E/W, Parasaurolophus and Deinosuchus. Small Compy/Velociraptor remain unchanged; Baryonyx N remains exact South180.
